quota.title: Quota Monitor
quota.subtitle: Remaining quota and reset opportunities via the CPA v8 plugin quota API.
quota.empty_hint: Make sure the cpa-quota plugin is enabled and at least one supported OAuth credential exists.
quota.reset_confirm_desc: This attempts to reset quota for {{name}} and may consume an upstream reset opportunity. Continue?

claude_reset.title: Reset Claude quota
claude_reset.desc: Choose a reset opportunity for {{name}}. Submitting consumes one upstream opportunity; review before continuing.
claude_reset.no_grants: This account has no reset opportunities
claude_reset.pending: A previous submission has an unknown outcome. Retrying reuses the same request id to avoid a double spend.
claude_reset.pending_other_grant: Another submission is unresolved; switching opportunities is blocked
claude_reset.hint_weekly: Refills the weekly allowance, possibly scoped to specific models
claude_reset.hint_window: Resets only windows that already have usage
claude_reset.cooldown_failed: Quota reset, but clearing the CPA cooldown failed; refresh manually
claude_reset.block_not_limited: No quota limit is currently reached
claude_reset.block_no_usage: This refill has no usage to restore and would be wasted
claude_reset.block_not_started: This opportunity is not active yet
claude_reset.result_not_limited: No quota limit is currently reached
claude_reset.error_auth: The Claude credential is no longer valid; sign in again
claude_reset.error_rate_limited: Too many requests; try again later
claude_reset.error_malformed: Upstream reset data could not be parsed
claude_reset.error_unknown_outcome: Reset outcome is unknown; retry the same opportunity
claude_reset.error_pending_other_grant: Another opportunity is unresolved; switching is blocked

key.title: Management key
key.desc: This page reads data through the CPA v8 management API and needs a management key.
key.label: Management key
key.ban_hint: Five consecutive authentication failures temporarily ban the IP. The page never sends requests without a key.

timeline.title: Quota timeline
timeline.desc: Project each account's quota windows across dates to see when capacity returns.
timeline.empty: No quota window can be drawn on this page. Try another page or the card view.
timeline.empty_month: No quota window can be drawn for this month. Try another page or the card view.
timeline.empty_session: No 5-hour quota window on this page. Try another page or the card view.
timeline.hint: Only windows with an inferable period are shown; see the card view for the rest.
